definitions.explanation: A rough, informal word for a man or boy. Used among men in casual settings, sometimes affectionately.

definitions.gloss: bastard; jerk; son of a bitch
definitions.explanation: Used as a term of contempt or anger toward someone, especially a man. Strong and rude.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{野郎|やろう}、⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しやがった。
examples.english: That guy showed up late, damn it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野郎|やろう}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a drinking party full of nothing but guys.

⟦ふざける→ふざける：09309_fuzakeru⟧な、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{野郎|やろう}！
examples.english: Don't mess with me, you bastard!

examples.english: I'll definitely catch the bastard who stole my wallet.

notes:
REGISTER:
{野郎|やろう} is a strongly masculine, rough word. It is used almost exclusively by men. Women rarely use this word except in very casual or deliberately rough speech.

USAGE:
The tone determines whether it is affectionate (sense 1) or hostile (sense 2). Among close male friends, it can be used playfully. Directed at strangers or enemies, it is an insult.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{野郎|やろう}！ (You bastard!)
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{野郎|やろう} (That bastard / That guy)
- {野郎|やろう}ども (you guys — rough, masculine plural)
- ばか{野郎|やろう} (stupid idiot — a very common compound insult)
